exact: regulation of isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate-independent pathway

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of isopentenyl diphosphate produced via the methylerythritol (MEP) pathway (mevalonate-independent).
label: regulation of isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway
